registration.method: Piecewise affine with padded global-affine continuation
registration.limitation: Control interpolation has zero internal residual by construction; it is not external validation. Elevation/perspective of the source artwork and manually traced apexes cause unresolved tens-of-metres placement uncertainty.

visibilityReview.browserPhotoResult: Historical 1.2m seated-eye candidate: all three viewports failed the former visible-car threshold. Superseded for current posture by standingReview; not independent proof of incorrect terrain.
visibilityReview.limitation: A low eye line intersects the retained regional ground surface. This is not certified as an accurate constructed-terrace occlusion; no terrain was flattened, eye raised, or source region trimmed to suppress it. Detailed hill survey remains unavailable.

standingReview.buildScope: Explicit local candidate preview only; production availability unchanged. Original source geometry, ground and vehicle retained.
standingReview.observation: Desktop export visually inspected: only the upper car silhouette is visible above foreground ground. Red-pixel threshold success does not certify full body visibility or correct hill construction.
standingReview.limitation: Real obstruction is possible. Source-map registration and constructed terrace/retaining-wall elevations still require independent corroboration; no artificial clearance applied.

structuralPhoto.observation: Organizer2026 ticket product uses this 4928x3280 photograph. It shows terraced grass platforms, retaining walls and stairs; proves a bare regional DTM is inadequate, but does not provide surveyed height controls. No numerical wall height inferred from a photo or sightline.

source.notes: Official event map linked from the organizer 2026 Grand Prix page. Hill viewing footprint manually traced separately from the surrounding blue Fan Zone and gold Hill Lounge. Piecewise-affine registration to 16 sourced turn coordinates, with affine continuation outside the hull. Schematic 3D artwork is not a survey; local placement may differ by tens of metres. Known road+0.75m and structure/pit+0.5m exclusions. 100m patches are computational partitions, not ticket sectors.

openingSource.notes: Organizer explicitly identifies General Admission Lusail Hill as the elevated Turn1 viewing area for 27–29 November2026. Ordinary public GA, not the separately sold Hill Lounge hospitality product.

surfaceSource.notes: Regional GEDTM30 v1.2 terrain at true vertical scale; no invented hill height or exaggerated grade. 0.04m mesh clearance and seated eye1.2m. The ~30m predicted terrain cannot resolve constructed terraces or individual viewing platforms; their precise geometry remains unavailable.

issues: Source-map registration has unresolved tens-of-metres uncertainty; constructed Hill terraces and retaining-wall elevations are not independently validated. Standing-eye photos retain partial ground occlusion, which alone does not prove a model error.
geometryReview.method: Candidate only: source-ground patches exclude known roads, pit lanes and recorded structures. Planar clearance does not certify a usable viewing elevation. No terrain flattened, eye raised or boundary trimmed to pass sightline tests.

facts: Circuit facilities renovation completed in 2023; the announcement names Lusail Hill among spectator facilities.
No numerical Hill height, terrace levels or surveyed section is supplied.
authority.limitation: The announcement does not independently date every part of the hill earthworks.

rejectedSubstitution.liveFetch: Web fetch timed out; inspected previously retained HTML only.
rejectedSubstitution.reason: The engineering case describes narrow-space underpass retaining walls, not a located Lusail Hill section. Do not transfer its drawings or dimensions to this hill.

terrainCompatibility.sourcePeriod: 2006-01-01 / 2015-12-31 as encoded in retained source raster identifier
terrainCompatibility.inference: Regional ground cannot validate the as-built 2023 spectator terraces or their retaining walls. This does not prove that every hill elevation is absent or that a blocked photo is erroneous.
terrainCompatibility.requiredEvidence: Post-renovation georeferenced Hill survey or independently located terrace/retaining-wall section, including its vertical datum.
